description: Thresholded production-rate transform followed by first-order gas-release lag.
Nonlinear production-rate transform followed by first-order gas-release lag.
Gas flow activates only above a fraction of the median production rate.
First-order gas-release/headspace lag: tau dq/dt = q_prod - q_out.
Current model: stripping gas flow is directly proportional to instantaneous ethanol-derived CO2 production.
Nonlinear effective gas flow: q_out = q_ref (q_prod/q_ref)^p.
